Title: Verify adding in-stock Grey Jacket from catalog displays accurate line item details and subtotal in cart
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront catalog with empty cart session
Steps:
1. Navigate to /collections/all
2. Select 'Grey jacket' product card
3. Click 'Add to Cart'
4. Verify header cart counter increments to 'My Cart (1)'
5. Navigate to /cart
6. Verify line item shows 'Grey jacket', unit price '£55.00', quantity '1', and line total '£55.00'
Expected Result: Grey jacket added to cart with counter updated to 1 and /cart correctly renders line item details with £55.00 unit price and subtotal
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/collections/all | Product: Grey jacket | Price: £55.00 | Qty: 1

Title: Verify Check Out button on cart page is active and initiates checkout with order summary
Preconditions: Grey jacket (£55.00) is present in cart
Steps:
1. Open /cart with Grey jacket present
2. Verify 'Check Out' button is visible and enabled
3. Click 'Check Out' button
4. Verify browser navigates to checkout URL (/checkouts/) and renders Checkout page with contact and delivery form
Expected Result: Navigates to checkout page (/checkouts/) displaying order summary with Grey jacket and active checkout fields
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/cart | Action: Check Out | Destination: /checkouts/

Title: Verify updating in-stock item quantity in cart recalculates subtotal accurately
Preconditions: Grey jacket is present in cart
Steps:
1. Open /cart with Grey jacket present
2. Update quantity field to '3'
3. Click 'Update' button
4. Verify line total and subtotal update to '£165.00'
Expected Result: Cart quantity updates to 3 and subtotal recalculates correctly to £165.00
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/cart | Product: Grey jacket | Updated Qty: 3 | Expected Total: £165.00

Title: Verify cart counter and added item details persist across catalog navigation and page reload
Preconditions: Grey jacket is added to cart session
Steps:
1. Add Grey jacket to cart
2. Navigate back to /collections/all
3. Verify header displays 'My Cart (1)'
4. Reload page
5. Verify header counter remains 'My Cart (1)' and /cart retains Grey jacket
Expected Result: Cart counter and item details persist consistently across catalog pages and browser reload
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/ | Counter: My Cart (1) | Persistence: True
